_doc: PLACEHOLDER — the radial cluster's CONDUCTION data: per-era light rigs (the cold-light-winning arc), the ceiling witness geometry, the witness record plane's E1 anchor, and the point-cloud Close parameters. The SPACE itself (the hexagon, the three wedge rooms, door, terminal frame, Maya's desk, the lamp carry) lives in data/room/reinterp_deltas.json and transforms via src/room/clusterMorph.ts — the shipped EraMorph grammar, ported (Rounds 21-22). COLOR LAW: every hex here already exists in data/room/era1.json; e2-e4 rig hues re-derive when era2+ theme palettes land. zoneFill = the two wedge rooms' accent omnis (light-zoneE = the trans-facet room / light-zoneW = the parallel-tracks bay); mayaGlow = Maya's E4 interface light.

witnessTerminal._note: the witness record plane's E1 position (4:3, same canvas); from r2 on it rides the spine to z 3.865 (cluster.ts PLANE_Z — the hexagon's rear face)

ceilingWitness._note: R8-3: presence only — light/eye-motif, NEVER reading. A square iris (pixel discipline: 90° geometry) recessed in the ceiling over the room's center; a pale sourceless wash when awake. Dormant until the O7 first filing.

rigs._note: Per-era light targets for the era1.json light ids + scene ambient. The arc: E1 lamp-dominant night (~70/30 warm) → E2 office-grade fluorescent (~50/50, managed) → E3 platform pastel (near-shadowless diffuse, the lamp a leftover) → E4 interface-lit near-dark (the cold has won; the lamp survives as the one warm pocket, CARRIED to Maya's desk). 'hold' = T1's lamp-only breath (choreography §T1.1). 'close' kills the room for the point-cloud inversion.

pointCloud._note: The Close's constellation (R1 confirmed; Gephi-style reference, Round 2): warm orange/yellow NODES on a cool blue LINK-WEB against a NIGHT-BLUE backdrop (Round 18: not black — 'we can't see'), dense center + scattered satellites, and LABELS on the hub nodes carrying the project's knowledge network (data/strings/close_network.json, PLACEHOLDER until Sérgio's pass). The inversion: warm nodes / cool web = the lamp's temperature at network scale. Hues = the lamp pool (#F7C775/#EFA13F), the moon face (#F3EAD8), the moonlight blue (#6C7BA8); backdrop = windowPane night #2C3A5C scaled down in code (a light level, not a new hue). Links are trimmed to node surfaces and never cross the player's clear bubble (the Round-18 clipping fix).
